subtitle: High-Yield Words in Context for the Digital SAT Reading and Writing Section.
instructions: Digital SAT Format: 35 seconds per item.
Words in Context: Select the term that best maintains text cohesion and tone.
Direct rationale provided after test completion.

questions.prompt: Critics noted that performing a 1920s jazz opera with actors clad in 21st-century cybernetic suits was intentionally ________, designed to bridge past and future aesthetics.
questions.explanation: 'Anachronistic' means chronologically misplaced or belonging to a different era.

questions.prompt: The bloom of the rare night-flowering cereus is famously ________; it opens for a single evening and withers by dawn.
questions.explanation: 'Ephemeral' denotes lasting for a very brief duration or fleeting existence.
